derivation: from a compound of G1218 (δῆμος) and G58 (ἀγορά);
def: to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly

occurrences.text: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.
